text: あんなやつに　この　かいしゃを　のっとられたら…

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb form says the thing is done to you, and the one who does it gets に. あんなやつに のっとられたら = 'if it gets taken over by a guy like that'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if that happens'. Here the rest is left unsaid, as a worry. のっとられたら… = 'if it gets taken over...'
